task.title: rle-encode
task.statement: The rle package exposes decode (already implemented) and a stub encode(s). Implement encode(s) so that it run-length encodes a string: each maximal run of one character becomes that character followed by the decimal count of the run (the count is always written, even when it is 1). For example encode('aaabbc') is 'a3b2c1', encode('abc') is 'a1b1c1', encode('') is ''. encode must return a str and must round-trip with decode (decode(encode(x)) == x for every string x). Raise TypeError when s is not a string. Do not change decode or the tests.
acceptance_criteria: TypeError when s is not a string

spec.infeasibility_reason: The required encoding format cannot round-trip every string through the unchanged decode. For example, encode('a1') must produce 'a111' (runs 'a1' and '11'), but decode('a111') returns 111 copies of 'a'. The decoder greedily consumes consecutive digits as a count. Satisfying the task requires relaxing the input domain or changing the encoding format and decoder; neither is authorized.
spec.restated_task: Implement rle.encode(s) to return a string formed by replacing each maximal run of an identical character with that character followed by its positive decimal run length, including counts of 1. Return an empty string for empty input and raise TypeError for non-string input. Preserve decode and existing tests. The additional requirement to round-trip every string conflicts with this format and the existing decoder.

interface_contract.name: rle.encode
interface_contract.behavior: Accept str instances, including subclasses. Process characters as Python string elements, without normalization. Emit each maximal contiguous run in input order as its character followed by its count in ASCII decimal digits without leading zeros. Always emit the count. Return a str; empty input returns ''. Universal round-trip behavior is requested but infeasible with the unchanged decoder.
error_cases: TypeError: s is not an instance of str.

interface_contract.name: rle.decode
interface_contract.behavior: Preserve the existing implementation exactly. For each token, take one character and greedily consume subsequent characters satisfying str.isdigit() as its count, convert the count using int(), and append that many copies of the character. Return the concatenated str; empty input returns ''.
error_cases: TypeError: s is not an instance of str.
ValueError: a token character is not followed by any character satisfying str.isdigit().
ValueError: the consumed count cannot be converted by int(), including digit characters that int() does not accept.

Sealed and adversarial suites run one child process per test under a supervisor that never imports candidate code and is the first step of its branch; two verifier canaries detect blanket result forgery. A candidate can still forge its own result from inside a child after the nonce was read if it spares the canaries (the mutation gate and held-out tests are the structural detectors).

The repository's own suite and the held-out suite run after the sealed verification in their own branches. They are bound through the same supervisor only for unittest repositories whose tests are statically discoverable; otherwise they are parsed from console output and the gate is labelled evidence_class 'stdout'.

Model-written sealed and adversarial tests can be wrong; their failures block VERIFIED. An independent arbiter classifies each failure (implementation bug, test defect or contract dispute) and, for pure test defects, offers a corrected module. The correction counts only after mechanical validation (same test methods, only the failing ones changed, passes on the candidate, still fails on the unmodified base or is caught by a mutant); the corrected gate is then re-run and the verdict re-derived from the gates. A sealed test that failed by assertion is never overridden. The classification itself remains a model judgement.

INFEASIBLE is recorded only when a witness program written by the contract auditor demonstrated the contradiction by running on the unmodified repository (exit code and output recorded); the witness's logic is the model's, its execution is not.
Grounding runs only when the specification names external references; sources are cited, not verified for correctness.

Sandbox raw 'cost' diagnostics are not USD; Codex gateway usage is ChatGPT allowance, not a Nebius charge; Nebius USD is computed from the public price table, not an invoice.
